sections.markdown: ## Total Spans & Logs Volume per day

  - `dt.sfm.spans.ingest.size`
  - `dt.sfm.storage.ingest.received_bytes`, filtering by `data.type:log`
- Click on the tile, and `Show input` for more details

sections.title: Spans Ingest a day per App

input.value:
timeseries daily_sum = sum(spans.ingest.size),
  interval: 1d,
  by: { dt.security_context }
| fieldsAdd
    avg_daily_sum = arrayAvg(daily_sum)

//add special retention requirements
| fieldsAdd
    retention_days = if(
        condition: contains(dt.security_context, "credit-card-order-service"),
        then: 360,
        else: "default"
    )

//if app (or BU) has more than 250GB, a separate bucket is recommended
| fieldsAdd
    ingest_higher_than_250GB_aDay = if(
        condition: avg_daily_sum > 268435456000,
        then: true,
        else: false
    )

// combine your two rules
| fieldsAdd
    needs_separate_bucket = (retention_days != "default") OR ingest_higher_than_250GB_aDay

// bucket name only when needed
| fieldsAdd
    bucket_name = if(
        condition: needs_separate_bucket,
        then: concat(dt.security_context, "_spans_", toString(retention_days)),
        else: null
    )
  
| fields dt.security_context, avg_daily_sum 
         ,retention_days  
         ,ingest_higher_than_250GB_aDay
         ,needs_separate_bucket
         ,bucket_name
| sort avg_daily_sum desc

| filter event.kind == "BILLING_USAGE_EVENT"
| filter event.type == "Log Management & Analytics - Ingest & Process"
| summarize sum = sum(billed_bytes), by:{dt.cost.product}
